description: This file contains utility functions for constructing CSS or selector strings based on various attributes and roles, used for locating elements in testing or automation contexts within the Playwright project.

methods.name: getByAttributeTextSelector
methods.description: Constructs a selector string for an attribute with specified text or RegExp, escaping the text appropriately.

methods.name: getByTestIdSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating elements by test ID attribute.

methods.name: getByLabelSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating elements by label text.

methods.name: getByAltTextSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating elements by alt text attribute.

methods.name: getByTitleSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating elements by title attribute.

methods.name: getByPlaceholderSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating elements by placeholder attribute.

methods.name: getByTextSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating elements by visible text.

methods.name: getByRoleSelector
methods.description: Constructs a selector string for elements with a specific role and optional properties.
